Thanks — I reviewed the CSV and vendor packet. Quick notes:
- Tax ID present but missing a W-9 signature page; I'll mark the vendor as provisional until we receive the signed W-9 (Emily, can you ask your finance team to send the signed W-9 PDF?).
- SKU NX-STD-01 appears twice: one line is "Nexera Standard - per seat" and the duplicate is labeled "Nexera Standard - subscription". We should consolidate to "Nexera Standard (subscription) — per seat" for clarity.
- Suggested provisional spend cap: $30,000 USD for the first 30 days to accommodate onboarding surges, with an automatic review after 30 days. This gives Nexera headroom while we confirm actual consumption.

Action plan:
1) I will create a provisional purchase reference token (PROV-4821) today and attach a placeholder provisional PO PDF noting the spend cap and required outstanding docs (signed W-9).
2) Once W-9 is received and verified, we'll convert PROV-4821 to a formal PO (PO-2026-4821) and send the signed PO PDF.
3) We'll update line-item descriptions to the consolidated SKU text and include unit pricing in the final PO.

Attachments: vendor-onboard-packet.pdf (stub) — includes the CSV and high-level vendor metadata.

Monica Patel

Monica — that plan works. A couple of small operational notes:

- If Nexera sends the signed W-9 by EOD, we can promote to final PO within 24 hours.

I'll add the ledger tag and the 80% alert once Monica creates the provisional token.

Thanks — Karthik
